title.zh: 辐鳍鱼类来源限定证据

description.en: Open the Explorer at Actinopterygii to inspect the linked, locator-bearing source claim together with this package's current occurrence context. This is a reproducible evidence entry point, not a phylogenetic result or a complete history of the group.
description.zh: 在探索器中打开辐鳍鱼类，结合本包当前的出现记录背景检查带有精确来源定位的关联声明。这是可复现的证据检查入口，不是系统发育结果，也不是该类群的完整历史。

limitations: The linked claim retains its own specimen, stratum, model, confidence and source-locator boundaries. The Explorer route does not establish an exact origin, global first or last appearance, direct ancestry, causal mechanism or package-specific phylogeny.

description.en: Open a source-bounded Actinopterygii time window in the map to inspect sampled occurrence context linked to this package.
description.zh: 在地图中打开有来源边界的辐鳍鱼类时间窗口，检查与本包关联的采样出现背景。

limitations: The interval follows the linked package range and claim; map markers are sampled records and do not establish a complete distribution, exact origination or extinction, or direct ancestry.

description.en: Compare cheirolepis-trailli and fukangichthys through package-linked claims and bounded occurrence context; this side-by-side route is an evidence inspection aid.
description.zh: 通过本包关联的声明与限定出现背景比较cheirolepis-trailli与fukangichthys；并列页面仅用于证据检查。

limitations: The two sides retain separate source, sampling, range and uncertainty boundaries; visual differences are not tests of evolutionary causation or a package-specific phylogeny.

title.zh: Cheirolepis 艾菲尔期标本地图

description.en: Open the map at 389.25 Ma for the late Eifelian Cheirolepis trailli sample, keeping its Scottish locality, named CT-scanned specimens, stratigraphic envelope and bounded occurrence sampling attached to the fossil-range claim.
description.zh: 在 389.25 Ma 打开地图，查看晚艾菲尔期 Cheirolepis trailli 样本，并保留苏格兰地点、具名 CT 扫描标本、地层年龄范围和有界出现记录采样所对应的化石范围声明。

limitations: Map markers are bounded occurrence rows from the Achanarras Limestone and correlated Scottish localities; the named CT-scanned museum specimens are incomplete and distributed across anatomical regions, the late Eifelian age envelope is rounded, the anatomical observations are not a population-wide character matrix, and the sampled records do not establish global FAD/LAD, complete distribution, direct ancestry or behavior.

title.zh: Fukangichthys 中三叠世地图样本

description.en: Open the map at 244.232 Ma for the Middle Triassic Fukangichthys longidorsalis sample from the Kelamayi Formation, retaining its named IVPP specimens, formation-scale age, CT-based matrix context and bounded occurrence sampling.
description.zh: 在 244.232 Ma 打开地图，查看来自克拉玛依组的中三叠世 Fukangichthys longidorsalis 样本，并保留具名 IVPP 标本、组级年龄、基于 CT 的矩阵背景和有界出现记录采样。

limitations: The map is limited to the Kelamayi Formation, Xinjiang, and the named IVPP V4096.6 and V4096.13 material; the Middle Triassic envelope is formation-scale, the CT-informed phylogenetic matrix is a sampled topology rather than a complete lineage record, and bounded occurrences do not establish global FAD/LAD, complete distribution, direct ancestry or behavior.

title.zh: Pseudopholidoctenus 鲁德斯多夫地图样本

description.en: Open the map at approximately 244 Ma for the lower Anisian Pseudopholidoctenus germanicus material from the Rüdersdorf Muschelkalk, with its named specimens, locality, age point and source-bounded sampling kept visible.
description.zh: 在约 244 Ma 打开地图，查看来自鲁德斯多夫穆舍尔卡尔克的安尼阶早期 Pseudopholidoctenus germanicus 材料，并保留具名标本、地点、年龄点和来源限定采样。

limitations: This point follows the Rüdersdorf quarry, lower middle Muschelkalk Fischmergel sample and holotype/paratypes MB.f.18641 and MB.f.19904–19906; approximately 244 Ma is a locality age point, the incomplete type material and study character matrix do not provide a population-wide range, and sampled markers do not establish global FAD/LAD, complete distribution, direct ancestry or behavior.

title.zh: Barschichthys 鲁德斯多夫地图样本

description.en: Open the map at approximately 244 Ma for the lower Anisian Barschichthys ruedersdorfensis material from Rüdersdorf, retaining its type specimens, partial referred trunk, Muschelkalk age point and bounded matrix and occurrence context.
description.zh: 在约 244 Ma 打开地图，查看鲁德斯多夫安尼阶早期 Barschichthys ruedersdorfensis 材料，并保留模式标本、部分所指躯干、穆舍尔卡尔克年龄点以及有界矩阵和出现记录背景。

limitations: The scene is limited to the Rüdersdorf opencast mine, lower middle Muschelkalk Fischmergel and holotype/paratypes MB.f.19907–19909; approximately 244 Ma is a single locality age point, the partial specimen and cited character matrix limit taxon and anatomy sampling, and the map does not establish global FAD/LAD, complete distribution, direct ancestry or behavior.

description.en: Open the map at approximately 244 Ma for the lower Anisian Ruedersdorfia berlinensis skull-roof sample from Rüdersdorf, keeping its named material, restricted matrix, locality and age limits attached to the fossil-range claim.
description.zh: 在约 244 Ma 打开地图，查看来自鲁德斯多夫的安尼阶早期 Ruedersdorfia berlinensis 头顶骨样本，并将具名材料、受限矩阵、地点和年龄限制保留在化石范围声明中。

limitations: The marker is limited to the Rüdersdorf opencast mine, lower middle Muschelkalk Fischmergel and skull roofs MB.f.19910, MB.f.14888 and MB.f.19911; approximately 244 Ma is a locality age point, the skull-roof-only material leaves the character matrix and body sampling incomplete, and this bounded record does not establish global FAD/LAD, complete distribution, direct ancestry or behavior.
